#gin-cartographer-stance MEASURED AUTHOR-REPORTED as of 2026-07-27 STALE

Adding a quantity/stance channel to the Cartographer relation detector raised its contradiction precision on a synthetic same-story corpus without losing recall.

Verification
Author-reported, not re-verified. No tier-1 artifact containing this claim was opened for this site.
Measured
Measurements for gin-cartographer-stance
MetricValuen / denominatorDatasetSyntheticSystemDate
within-event precision0.632 -> 1.00012/19 -> 12/12 (tp 12, fp 0)node5 same-story corpus, authored by the same person who labeled ityesCartographer + stance channel, all-MiniLM-L6-v2 + nli-deberta-v3-xsmall, scripts/eval_node5_stance.py2026-07-27
precision incl. cross-event pairs0.500 -> 0.923tp 12, fp 1 aftersameyessame2026-07-27
recall1.00012 of 12sameyessame2026-07-27
Does not show
Performance on text the author did not write. The corpus is synthetic and its patterns were authored by the person who labeled it, which is why Node6 (a blind collaborator corpus) was set up.
Sources disagree
The seed paired 0.632 -> 0.923 as one metric. In the spec, 0.632 is the within-event baseline and 0.923 is the cross-event-inclusive precision after the change; they are different metrics. The seed called the channel 'model-free'; the measured pipeline includes an NLI model. Verification stays AUTHOR-REPORTED because the numbers are in a spec's results section, not a committed eval output.
Evidence
